decisions.reason: As a recently launched multi-model product line built on the firm's core automation offer and central to its announced automated precast direction, it represents substantial engineering investment and visible commitment, and any weak early results can still be attributed to the startup phase and the construction downturn.

The production analysis software fits the firm's integrated, future-ready production strategy and was only launched in 2024, so it is too early to judge it a failure, and dropping it would undercut the publicly announced digital and automation direction.
